prompts.prompt: Create a high fidelity Chinese desktop application UI design concept for Piora Harmony device workbench. ui-mockup. Reference is the current real source-rendered panel; redesign radically with polished feasible desktop productivity UI, not marketing website. Flat front-on full window, crisp precise Chinese typography, desktop landscape 16:10. Preserve actual available capabilities: read-only screen mirror, device selector, USB connected state, capture screenshot, recording, applications, files, databases, commands, scenario tests, voice, logs, tasks, device settings. Do NOT imply phone screen is clickable. Label mirror '只读投屏'. Use short legible Chinese. Content is simulated, put small '设计预览 · 模拟数据' in chrome. No fake performance statistics, no extra dashboard KPIs. Device name 'HUAWEI Mate 70 Pro'. Render phone Settings screen with simplified Chinese lists. Avoid huge hero headings. Show actual interaction states in the concept, not detached annotation boxes. Direction: quiet warm-white native workbench, charcoal typography and restrained cobalt blue. Dense but calm. Slim Piora global shell rail far left, second narrow vertical grouped navigation: 设备 / 投屏 / 应用 / 文件 / 数据库, 调试 / 命令 / 测试 / 日志, 最近任务. Main current page FILES: breadcrumb, directory tree, elegant file table with notes.txt selected, right text preview with sticky 保存/对比 toolbar. Slim phone mirror pinned at right, small footer 截图 / 录屏. Device status appears once in top header. One expanded task activity strip at bottom showing screenshot saved and file transfer progress. Windows native buttons, 8px corners, hairline separators, generous but efficient spacing. Strong visual hierarchy. All controls plausible.
